article.title_es: Church of God of Woodycrest Ave: despensa de alimentos en el Bronx
article.title_en: Church of God of Woodycrest Ave: food pantry in the Bronx
article.summary_es: Esta iglesia en el Bronx aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC como despensa de alimentos. Atiende los sábados de 10 am a 1 pm, el segundo y cuarto sábado del mes.
article.summary_en: This Bronx church is listed on the City's Food Help NYC map as a food pantry. It is open Saturdays 10am-1pm, on the 2nd and 4th Saturday of the month.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC de la Ciudad.
Está ubicada en 923 Woodycrest Ave, Bronx, NY 10452.
Abre los sábados de 10 am a 1 pm, el segundo y cuarto sábado del mes.
Puede llamar al (718) 992-4087 para preguntar antes de ir.
how_they_help_en: It is a food pantry listed on the City's Food Help NYC map.
It is located at 923 Woodycrest Ave, Bronx, NY 10452.
It is open Saturdays 10am-1pm, on the 2nd and 4th Saturday of the month.
You can call (718) 992-4087 to ask questions before visiting.
